title: Cebu City councilor calls for freeze on north, upland housing projects

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Councilor Alvin Arcilla is seeking a temporary suspension of new high-density residential developments in the city’s north and upland areas. He cited water supply shortages and worsening traffic congestion in communities already experiencing pressure on basic infrastructure.
